purpose: Two fixed manual hypotheses evaluated for pre-return data coverage only; no proof of novelty or alpha

candidates.formula: signed_log1p((printed_yoy_lower + printed_yoy_upper) / 2 / 100); exact points have identical endpoints
candidates.rationale: Stronger disclosed earnings guidance may contain information beyond technical features; this is growth guidance, not analyst-consensus surprise.

candidates.formula: signed_log1p(printed_yoy_lower / 100); exact points use the point value
candidates.rationale: The conservative endpoint of explicitly disclosed guidance may be informative; no assumption that point guidance has zero uncertainty.

missing_policy: Approximate points, open bounds, qualitative or quarantined guidance excluded; non-event days null; every newer forecast or express clears the old forecast; no vendor completion
next_gate: Only coverage passing candidates may receive a separately frozen return/model protocol; this batch cannot open protected observations or spend an existing study budget
